title: how to add form in the website page

posts.name: Yasir Mansour
posts.cooked:
Hello Dears;

I need help to add form “AS A SECTION” into the website landoing page.?

Thank you

posts.name: Priytesh
posts.cooked:
Hi Y.S Mansour

Seems like you want to embed a Frappe Web Form as a section inside your website’s landing page rather than having it as a separate page.

Here’s how you can do that without breaking anything in core.

1. Understanding the options

In Frappe there are two main ways to add a form into a webpage section:

Option A – Embed the Web Form iframe

  • Easiest way — just load the web form in an <iframe> inside your landing page.
  • Works even if the web form is in a different app/site.
  • Downside: styling might not perfectly match your page unless you customize CSS.

Option B – Use Web Template + Frappe Form Components

  • You create a custom web template in your app.
  • Pull the Web Form fields using Jinja or HTML directly inside that section.
  • Submit data using Frappe’s form POST endpoint or a custom whitelisted method.

2. Example — Embed an existing Web Form inside a landing page section

Let’s say you already have a Web Form at:
https://yoursite.com/feedback

You can add this to your landing page like so:

In your landing_page.html:

<section id="feedback-section" style="padding: 40px; background-color: #f8f9fa;">
    <h2>Send us your Feedback</h2>
    <iframe src="/feedback"
            style="width: 100%; height: 600px; border: none; overflow: hidden;"
            frameborder="0">
    </iframe>
</section>

3. Example — Creating a reusable “Form Section” web template

  1. In Frappe, go to:
    2.Website → Web Template → New*
  2. Name it: Form Section
  3. Content:
<section class="form-section">
    <h2>{{ title }}</h2>
    <iframe src="{{ form_url }}" style="width:100%; height:{{ height }}px; border:none;"></iframe>
</section>
  1. Add template variables:
  • title (Data)
  • form_url (Data)
  • height (Int)

Now you can drop this template anywhere in a Web Page Builder layout and just pass the form URL.

4. If you want a fully integrated form without iframe

  • Copy the fields from the Web Form’s doctype into your landing page HTML.
  • Use Frappe’s frappe.call or HTML <form> to submit to:
/api/method/frappe.website.doctype.web_form.web_form.accept
  • Pass the web_form name and field values in the POST data.

This way, the form will look and feel like it’s part of the landing page and not a separate embed.
